mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.5 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% triggers a negative market reaction due to deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by more than 0.5% in the prior month indicates a severe demand shock, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decline > 0.5% and HOUST decline > 0.5% in prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS and HOUST both decline by more than 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In active monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS < 3.0%), a decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals deflationary pressures that reduce corporate profit expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS < 3.0% and CPIAUCSL declines by more than 0.2% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rising employment level (PAYEMS) signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS increases by at least 0.3% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (relative to 2017=100) triggers a negative market reaction due to weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly real GDP (GDPC1) relative to the previous quarter indicates economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 increases by at least 0.5% from the prior quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level above 1500.0 (thousands of units) signals strong demand for housing, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1500.0.
